title: tragacantha sahendi
intro: Tragacantha sahendi, commonly known as Persian silk tassel bush, is a flowering plant species in the pea family. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha sahendi include wound healing, anti-arthritic effects, and the modulation of the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
